purpose: Audit Baton's bidirectional communication from inside a suborchestrated swarm

participants.role: Audit what a swarm participant can SAY via swarm.update. Exercise every channel once and record the exact result (including errors, verbatim): swarm.work_updated (open a unit of work), swarm.assignment_updated, swarm.holder_released (expect refusal while a live participant holds seats — record the refusal text verbatim), swarm.context_updated, swarm.contribution_recorded, and one action OUTSIDE your permissions: attempt swarm.recruit and record the refusal text verbatim. Also test swarm.update for work and assignment where possible. Note which of your utterances produce a wake for the suborchestrator (it is watching). Write docs/audits/2026-09-14-swarm-communication/probe-say.md with findings (quote exact texts and timestamps), then publish swarm.contribution_recorded naming that file. Write only under docs/audits/2026-09-14-swarm-communication/. Never print environment variables containing tokens.

work-say.objective: Audit what a swarm participant can SAY: each update kind, out-of-permission refusal text, wake production

plan: probe-see: publish a context note containing the text "guide me"; the suborchestrator will swarm.guide you; observe how guidance appears; then audit view/subtree/attention/watch and write docs/audits/2026-09-14-swarm-communication/probe-see.md; contribute naming that file

probe-say: exercise each update kind once, attempt swarm.recruit (outside your permissions) and record the refusal verbatim, note which utterances wake the suborchestrator, write docs/audits/2026-09-14-swarm-communication/probe-say.md; contribute naming that file
both: quote exact refusal texts and timestamps; write only under docs/audits/2026-09-14-swarm-communication/; never print env tokens
